title: Offer kanso-jetbrains upstream
description:
0.1.0 builds and passes nix flake check (palette drift; merged-theme tests: no stock colors, UI text >= 4.5:1, code >= 3:1) and Plugin Verifier against IU-263.7307.200 (Compatible). The repository is public and release v0.1.0 carries the jar.

Next: ask the kanso.nvim author whether they want the port; optionally publish to JetBrains Marketplace.
